title: Parliamentary Business Resources Amendment (Voluntary Opt-out) Bill 2017
short_title: Parliamentary Business Resources Amendment (Voluntary Opt-out) Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would give senators and members of the House of Representatives a statutory way to voluntarily forgo some or all of their parliamentary remuneration.
A parliamentarian could make a written election at any time, specifying either a percentage or an amount of remuneration to be forgone under the scheme.
The scheme would begin the day after Royal Assent, and an election would operate from its nominated start date until revoked under the prescribed process.
changes: The law would set requirements for the election's contents and the recipient of the notice.
An election would reduce remuneration through a statutory calculation.
Parliamentarians could vary an election while it remains effective.
summary.affected: Senators and members of the House of Representatives would be affected.
